content: I'm a hefty 200lb, 5'5" lady. I wear a women's shoe size 8, but I got the size 9s, cause I read they run small. I'm a wildlife rescue volunteer and we had to get some domestic ducks out of a Very muddy pond so they could clean it.Pros: They fit my fatness, boobs and all. The belt part really helps. I was worried when I saw how long the leg parts were compared to my shorter legs, but with adjustment, I was able to say no to the "toe!" The boots were a bit loose, but the ankle part was snug enough to keep them from flopping off. PLUS: they have a little heel ridge thingie that helps you pry them loose with the opposite foot, so you don't have to touch gooey boots! They also have a handy inward-facing flap pocket, which was awesome to carry my knife for cutting rope. And they didn't rip or leak.Cons: If you're using one of those dumb "fishing tubes," Don't Tip Backwards! I was doing really well until I lost my balance and tipped backwards, legs sprawled forward, and the water rushed in! Eeek! Bending over makes the back pull down. Lesson learned. Also, I do not recommend these for water-based aerobics, yoga, or karate. They don't stretch and I'd be worried they'd rip if you bend too far. Normally, I can touch my toes, in these, I can only bend halfway down. Also- No Squats!I highly recommend wearing sweat-wicking pants and shirt underneath, as you will most-likely get sweaty inside.In the end, we caught the ducks and took them to safety, and I looked no more silly than the other volunteers getting stuck in the mud! Success!
content_zh: 我是个身高5英尺5英寸、体重200磅的丰满女士。我穿女鞋8码，但买了9码，因为看到评论说尺码偏小。我是野生动物救援志愿者，我们需要把一些家鸭从一个非常泥泞的池塘里救出来，以便清理池塘。优点：它们适合我的体型，包括胸部和所有部位。腰带部分很有帮助。一开始看到裤腿长度相对于我的短腿来说很长，我有点担心，但调整后，我成功避免了“脚趾”问题！靴子有点松，但脚踝部分足够紧，不会脱落。另外：靴子后跟有个小凸起，可以用另一只脚把它撬下来，这样就不用碰黏糊糊的靴子了！还有一个方便的内向 flap 口袋，非常适合放我的刀来割绳子。而且它们没有撕裂或漏水。缺点：如果你用那种愚蠢的“钓鱼管”，千万别向后倒！我本来做得很好，直到失去平衡向后倒，腿向前伸，水就灌进来了！哎呀！弯腰时背部会往下拉。吸取教训了。另外，我不推荐用于水上健身操、瑜伽或空手道。它们没有弹性，我担心弯腰过度会撕裂。通常我能摸到脚趾，但穿着它们只能弯到一半。还有——别做深蹲！我强烈建议在里面穿吸湿排汗的裤子和衬衫，因为你很可能会出汗。最后，我们抓住了鸭子并把它们带到安全的地方，我看起来并不比那些陷在泥里的其他志愿者更傻！成功！

content: I just opened the box and tried them on! This is my first impression Im a Salmon fishermen born and raised in Alaska and now fish along the Oregon coast and have 60 plus years of fishing experience and  I fish where chest waders are a must because of the Ocean surf. I'm tired of paying for expensive waders only to get one season out of them. There's nothing worse than leaky waders only to have to put them on the next day cold and wet. Its not fun being wet and uncomfortable. So I purchased these budget waders in hope's of just getting one season out of them. Lets get to it! The packaging was nice and done well after opening the box and plastic bag I could smell the out gasing of the PVC material so you might want to hang them in your garage and not in your clothes closet or you might be in the dog house. The materials however look pretty good the shoulder straps are wide and fully adjustable nice buckles along with the waist belt. There is a small front pocket maybe to hold your fishing License or cell phone. Im 6'-2" tall and weigh 250 pounds dressed and have size a 13 D foot so I followed the size recommendation and ordered one size larger a 14 however the boots are snug and aren't wide I dont have much room for two socks so think about that if you're standing in really cold water could be a issue. The boots themselves are very Flimsy and aren't made for rough terrain but for sand bars and small sized gravel they will be fine. The boot tread are good and should work. So the overall fit of the waders are really smaller than described the inseam length is alot shorter and the bend at the knees are tighter than I like so sitting down is snug in the legs but it's just ok. The total height of the waders are ok and I would say they are designed for a Slender skinny guys without a beer belly or if your planning to wear alot of heavy clothes underneath these they might not be for you. Also something to consider is these waders don't breathe so if your planning to use them in a warm climate you may sweat alot however the waders should work fine in cooler waters and rainy days also they do weigh about six pounds. These waders aren't for bush wacking but for open areas. So tomorrow I will give these babies the water test and see how they do and will post my findings feel free to ask me questions I would be happy to help. I hope my Experiment worksInexpensive waiters every year. For the price point and what Im seeing so far these might be a hook up.. 2nd entry (The Water Test) well after spending the last five days in the ocean surf fishing the waders have Moisture inside both legs and boots my socks are damp and my pants also are damp. Its really hard to tell if its water weeping into the waders thru the fabric or sweat do to full sun exposure and exercise. but here we are again with damp waders hmmmm its not what I had in mind but Im not Soaking wet either and the waders seem to dry overnight which is good thing, I pulled the upper legs down to the boot tops for maximum ventilation. Im reducing the rating to 3 stars and will try to get another 30 days out of them hopefully. I will date when I have more input. Good luck!
content_zh: 我刚打开盒子试穿了一下！这是我的第一印象。我是一名鲑鱼渔民，在阿拉斯加出生和长大，现在在俄勒冈海岸捕鱼，有60多年的捕鱼经验。我在必须穿胸式涉水裤的地方捕鱼，因为海浪很大。我厌倦了花大价钱买昂贵的涉水裤，却只能用一季。没有什么比涉水裤漏水更糟糕的了，第二天还得穿上又冷又湿的裤子。又湿又不舒服，一点也不好玩。所以我买了这条预算款涉水裤，希望能用一季就行。开始吧！包装很好，打开盒子和塑料袋后，我能闻到PVC材料的气味，所以你可能想把它挂在车库里，而不是衣柜里，否则可能会被赶出家门。不过材料看起来不错，肩带很宽，可完全调节，搭扣和腰带都很好。有一个小前袋，也许可以放钓鱼证或手机。我身高6英尺2英寸，体重250磅，穿13D码的鞋，所以我按照尺码建议买大了一码，14码，但靴子很紧，不宽，我没有太多空间穿两双袜子，所以如果你站在非常冷的水里，这可能是个问题。靴子本身非常脆弱，不适合崎岖地形，但在沙洲和小砾石上没问题。靴底花纹不错，应该能用。整体合身度比描述的要小得多，内缝长度短很多，膝盖弯曲处比我喜欢的要紧，所以坐下时腿部有点紧，但还可以。涉水裤的总高度还行，我觉得它们是设计给身材苗条、没有啤酒肚的人穿的，或者如果你打算在里面穿很多厚衣服，可能不适合你。另外需要注意的是，这些涉水裤不透气，所以如果你打算在温暖的气候中使用，可能会出很多汗，但在较冷的水中和雨天应该没问题，它们重约六磅。这些涉水裤不适合在灌木丛中穿行，只适合开阔区域。所以明天我会给它们做防水测试，看看效果如何，然后发布我的发现。有问题可以问我，我很乐意帮忙。希望我的实验能成功——每年买便宜的涉水裤。就价格和我目前看到的而言，这些可能是个不错的选择。第二次记录（防水测试）：在海洋冲浪钓鱼五天后，涉水裤两条腿和靴子内部都有湿气，我的袜子和裤子都湿了。很难判断是水通过面料渗入涉水裤，还是因为阳光直射和运动出汗。但再次遇到湿涉水裤，嗯……这不是我想要的，但我也没有完全湿透，涉水裤似乎一夜之间就干了，这是好事。我把裤腿上部拉到靴子顶部，以获得最大通风。我把评分降到3星，希望能再用30天。有更多信息时我会更新。祝好运！

content: These are good-quality waders at a fair price.  I do surf fishing in California for striped bass.  I've gone through several pairs of more-expensive stocking-foot waders that always start leaking after a season or so.  I decided to give boot-foot waders a try.  I have used these new waders around 10 time so far and no leaks.  The quality seems really good and there are exterior and interior pockets that I use to hold my cell phone and car keys.  The wading belt and suspenders are nice and sturdy.  There is an included hanger to suspend the waders by the boots while drying.  I like boot foot vs. stocking foot since it is easier to rinse off the sand.  The only downside is that boot foot is not as comfortable as stocking foot.  My feet slide around a bit in the boots, which feels like it could cause a blister through my socks.  My older stocking-foot waders were more comfortable since I'd wear crocs over the stocking feet, which felt nice and snug.  I'm content with these boot foot.  I will still likely get a second pair of stocking foot for the times when I have a long hike to the fishing spot and need my feet to be more comfortable during that hike.  BTW if these waders start to leak I won't hesitate to buy another pair since they are so affordable.  I'm happy if the waders last a season or two.

content: I did finally get a hole, but it was from my own negligence, i drove my knee into a sharp stick while climbing up a hillside, i dont think any waders would have taken it well. However, the soles are durable and have really good tread, but the feel of them isnt the best, id get some insoles. The pvc is thin but does seem durable as i havent worn the knees or the butt out at all in the time ive had them (6 months or so, frequent river & creek fishing trips from summer into winter). I havent had any leakage until i had a dumby attack not too long ago, and if you layer up and wear your woolies you can still go duck hunting and fishing well into winter, ive used these in temps down to 8°F and been fine with the proper layers to go with, in the summer they arent too bad but you will probably end up sweating a good bit and not realize it till you take them off. Pretty sure sweating and waders go almost hand in hand when its above freezing out. I will say tho, since these are a one size fits all, im a bit smaller than average as far as my frame goes so the shoulder straps are always a little loose, but its not too bad
